prompt:
Create a replacement RUN CYCLE sprite sheet for this exact game character. The supplied sheet is ONLY identity/costume/style reference; its leg animation is incorrect. Transparent background. Exactly FIVE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS of ten complete character sprites, all facing RIGHT. No labels. Pixel art at reference detail. Entire weapon, feet and hair fit each equal cell with transparent gutters. Fixed camera/character scale and hip location. Draw a real bilateral running stride, NOT copies of one lunging pose. The NEAR LEG is brighter and visible, FAR LEG slightly darker behind. Exactly chronological:
1 NEAR foot forward touching ground; FAR thigh back with heel lifted behind.
2 NEAR leg vertical supporting weight; FAR knee swings forward past support leg.
3 NEAR leg extends BACK pushing off; FAR knee FORWARD high and bent; the knees cross.
4 flight: NEAR leg trails BACK with heel tucked near buttocks; FAR shin extends FORWARD ready to land.
5 FAR foot forward touches ground; NEAR heel high behind.
6 FAR leg supports vertically; NEAR thigh swings forward past support leg.
7 FAR leg pushes BACK, NEAR knee raised FORWARD.
8 flight: FAR leg trails BACK bent; NEAR shin extends FORWARD.
9 NEAR foot reaches ground FORWARD, FAR heel tucks behind.
10 NEAR leg takes weight and FAR leg leaves ground, blend back to pose1.
Important pose3 has NEAR thigh behind torso, pose7 has NEAR thigh IN FRONT of torso: this reversal MUST visibly happen. Preserve TWO legs only, correct hips/knees/ankles and shoes. Alternate left/right contacting feet, bent recovery legs, flight and passing silhouettes. Keep torso lean stable, head steady with slight vertical bounce, free arm counter-swings, sword held safely with stable orientation. No sword attacks, no blurry legs, no long spread legs in every frame, no duplicate poses, no ground/background/checkerboard, no outlines around cells.
